thesis: CDNA is in a clean uptrend with high-quality, profitable, cash-rich fundamentals, and the pullback from the 10/30 gap-up has been orderly, with volume drying up as price held the 75.8 area. Buying in the 75.8-79.0 entry zone avoids chasing and puts the stop under a defined swing low. Revenue growth of 39.3% YoY with low dilution risk supports a retest of the 52-week high. The case is only moderate, though: reward/risk is a modest 1.4, valuation is rich, the market regime is risk-off, and the news feed was blocked so offering risk is unchecked, so any position should be small.
